import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;

public class Codeforces933D {
	public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
		long n = Long.parseLong(st.nextToken());
		
		int counter = 0;
		int N = 1000000007;
		
		for (int i = 0; i < 500000; i++) {
			counter += firstsum(n, 4*i+1);
			counter -= firstsum(n, 4*i+3);
			counter %= N;
		}
		
		for (int b = 1; b <= n/2000000; b++) {
			counter += secondsum(n, b);
			counter %= N;
		}
				
		int ans = (2*((2*counter)%N))%N;
		long k = ((((((n%N)*(n%N+1))%N)*(n%N+2))%N)*166666668)%N;
		ans = (ans + (int) k)%N;
		System.out.println(ans);
	}
	
	//1/2 = 500000004
	//1/3 = 333333336
	//1/6 = 166666668
	//lmao
	public static int firstsum(long n, long q) {
		int N = 1000000007;
		long floornq = (n/q)%N;
		n %= N;
		q %= N;
		long sum = ((floornq*(floornq+1))/2)%N;
		long sumsquare = (((sum*(2*floornq+1))%N)*333333336)%N;
		long sumcube = (sum*sum)%N;
		long nsquare = (n*n)%N;
		long qsquare = (q*q)%N;
		long qcube = (q*qsquare)%N;
		
		long k1 = (nsquare*floornq - qsquare*sumsquare + n*floornq + q*sum)%N;
		if (k1 < 0)
			k1 += N;
		k1 = (k1*(n+1))%N;
		k1 = (k1*500000004)%N;
		
		long k2 = (((((n*(n+1))%N)*(2*n+1))%N)*166666668)%N;
		k2 = (k2*floornq)%N;
		
		long k3 = (((qcube*sumcube)%N)*333333336)%N;
		k3 -= (((qsquare*sumsquare)%N)*500000004)%N;
		k3 += (((q*sum)%N)*166666668)%N;
		
		long ans = (k1-k2+k3)%N;
		if (ans < 0)
			ans += N;
		return (int) ans;
	}
	
	//wtf who successfully codes this up in a real round?
	public static int secondsum(long n, long b) {
		int N = 1000000007;
		long bsquare = (b*b)%N;
		long bcube = (b*bsquare)%N;
		long max = (n/(4*b)-1)%N;
		long numk = (max + N + 1 - 500000)%N;
		long sumk = ((max)*(max+1)/2 + 250875)%N;
		long sumksquare = ((((long) max * (long) (max+1))%N * (long) (2*max + 1))%N * 166666668)%N-375084213;
		if (sumksquare < 0)
			sumksquare += N;
				
		long k1 = (((bcube*sumksquare)%N)*32)%N;
		long k2 = (((bsquare*sumk)%N * (4*b-1)%N)%N *8)%N;
		long k3 = ((26*bcube - 12*bsquare + b)%N * 333333336)%N;
		if (k3 < 0)
			k3 += N;
		k3 = (k3*numk)%N;
		long k4 = (((n+1)%N)*(b*(numk*(((4*b*500000 + 4*b*max)+4*b-1)%N)%N)%N))%N;
		
		long k5 = 0;
		long k6 = 0;
		
		if (n%(4*b) >= b) {
			long min2 = ((4*b)*(n/(4*b))+b)%N;
			long max2 = (Math.min((4*b)*(n/(4*b))+3*b-1, n))%N;
			//sum from min2 to max2 of (n+1-i)*i
			k5 = (((((max2*(max2+1))%N)*(2*max2+1))%N)*166666668)%N;
			k5 -= (((((((min2-1)*min2)%N)*(2*min2-1))%N)*166666668)%N);
			k6 = ((max2*(max2+1) - min2*(min2-1))/2)%N;
			k6 = (k6*((n+1)%N))%N;
		}
				
		return (int) ((k4-k1-k2-k3-k5+k6+7*(long)N)%N);
	}
	
}
